title: ServiceRadar Native Add-on Manifest (addon.yaml)
description: Schema for a first-party native ServiceRadar agent add-on manifest (issue 3425). The manifest is authored as YAML (addon.yaml) and validated (after YAML->JSON normalization) against this schema before the signed bundle is assembled. The build fails closed on a manifest that is missing required fields or declares an unknown kind/delivery/supervision value.

id.title: Add-on identifier
id.description: Stable, lowercase, hyphen/underscore-delimited identifier for the add-on.

kind.title: Add-on kind
kind.description: The add-on packaging kind. Only native add-ons are described by this schema.

delivery.title: Delivery model
delivery.description: How the add-on artifact reaches the agent.

supervision.title: Supervision model
supervision.description: How the agent supervises the add-on at runtime.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: Capability strings this add-on provides; at least one is required.

base_agent.title: Required base agent version constraint
base_agent.description: A version constraint on the base serviceradar-agent (e.g. ">=1.2.0").

agent_capabilities.title: Required agent capabilities
agent_capabilities.description: Capabilities the base agent must advertise before this add-on can be assigned. Empty by default.

os_capabilities.title: Required OS capabilities
os_capabilities.description: Linux capabilities the add-on requires (e.g. CAP_NET_RAW). Empty by default.

run_as.title: Run-as user
run_as.description: OS user the add-on is expected to run as.

plugin.title: go-plugin protocol settings
plugin.description: Settings for the HashiCorp go-plugin transport the agent uses to supervise an agent-sidecar add-on.

resources.title: Resource limits
resources.description: CPU and memory limits the agent supervisor (agent-sidecar) and the systemd unit generator (systemd-service) enforce for this add-on. Add-ons that perform on-host compute (for example per-series anomaly detection) MUST declare limits so they cannot impact the host or the base agent. Omitted means unbounded, which is only acceptable for trivial control-only add-ons.

cpu_max_percent.title: Max CPU percent
cpu_max_percent.description: Maximum CPU as a percentage of a single core (100 = one full core). Maps to systemd CPUQuota and cgroup cpu.max.

memory_max_bytes.title: Hard memory limit (bytes)
memory_max_bytes.description: Hard memory ceiling; the add-on is killed if it exceeds this. Maps to systemd MemoryMax and cgroup memory.max.

memory_high_bytes.title: Soft memory pressure threshold (bytes)
memory_high_bytes.description: Soft threshold above which the kernel reclaims aggressively before the hard limit. Maps to systemd MemoryHigh. Should be <= memory_max_bytes.

tasks_max.title: Max tasks/threads
tasks_max.description: Maximum number of tasks (threads) the add-on may spawn. Maps to systemd TasksMax.

slice.title: systemd slice
slice.description: Optional systemd slice to place the add-on under for shared accounting (for example "serviceradar-addons.slice").

artifacts.title: Signed per-architecture artifacts
artifacts.description: Per-architecture artifact descriptors populated by the signed-bundle build (native-addon-builds). Omitted in reference/source manifests.

install_path.title: Install path
install_path.description: Absolute path the add-on binary is installed under.

state_dirs.title: State directories
state_dirs.description: Absolute directories the add-on is allowed to read/write at runtime.

config_schema.title: Config schema reference
config_schema.description: Relative path (within the bundle) to the JSON-Schema the control plane validates add-on configuration against.

producer_schedules.title: Producer schedule contracts
producer_schedules.description: Declarative schedules materialized as disabled operator state when the package is imported or updated.

signal_schemas.title: Telemetry signal schema references
signal_schemas.description: Declarative log/event payload schemas and display contracts shipped with this add-on package. Required for add-ons that emit logs or events.

version.title: Signal schema version
version.description: Semantic version of the producer payload schema.

payload_kind.title: Payload kind
payload_kind.description: Canonical platform payload shape described by this schema.

payload_schema.title: Payload JSON Schema path
payload_schema.description: Relative JSON file path inside the add-on bundle.

display_contract.title: Display contract path
display_contract.description: Relative JSON file path inside the add-on bundle.
